Aquaplaning.fact: Aquaplaning or hydroplaning by the tires of a road vehicle, aircraft or other wheeled vehicle occurs when a layer of water builds between the wheels of the vehicle and the road surface, leading to a loss of traction that prevents the vehicle from responding to control inputs. Arianism.fact: By 325, the controversy had become significant enough that the Emperor Constantine called an assembly of bishops, the First Council of Nicaea, which condemned Arius's doctrine and formulated the original Nicene Creed of 325.

Arianism.subject: Applied Sciences

Arianism.subject: Applied Sciences
Arianism.question: In the Arian view, God the _____ is a deity and is divine; the Son of God is not a deity, but is still divine
Arianism.fact: The focus of the Council of Nicaea was the nature of the Son of God and his precise relationship to God the Father. (See Paul of Samosata and the Synods of Antioch.) Arius taught that Jesus Christ was divine or holy and was sent to Earth for the salvation of mankind, but that Jesus Christ was not equal to God the Father (infinite, primordial origin) in rank, and that God the Father and the Son of God were not equal to the Holy Spirit.

Arianism.subject: Applied Sciences
Arianism.question: God the _____ sent Jesus to earth for salvation of mankind
Arianism.fact: (See Paul of Samosata and the Synods of Antioch.) Arius taught that Jesus Christ was divine or holy and was sent to Earth for the salvation of mankind, but that Jesus Christ was not equal to God the Father (infinite, primordial origin) in rank, and that God the Father and the Son of God were not equal to the Holy Spirit. Under Arianism, Christ was instead not consubstantial with God the Father since both the Father and the Son under Arius were made of "like" essence or being (see homoiousia) ...

Arianism.subject: Applied Sciences

Arianism.fact: Ousia is essence or being, in Eastern Christianity, and is the aspect of God that is completely incomprehensible to mankind and human perception.

Arianism.subject: Applied Sciences
Arianism.question: It is all that subsists by itself and which has not its being in another, God the Father and God the Son and God the _____ all being uncreated
Arianism.fact: It is all that subsists by itself and which has not its being in another, God the Father and God the Son and God the Holy Spirit all being uncreated.

Arianism.subject: Applied Sciences
Arianism.question: His opponents argued that this would make _____ less than God and that this was heretical

Arianism.subject: Applied Sciences

Arianism.fact: This ecumenical council declared that Jesus Christ was true God, co-eternal and consubstantial (i.e., of the same substance) with God the Father.
